title: HoT content file (common header)
description: Every file in content/ must carry its version and who reviewed it (A14 §7, ADR-05). contentCompile enforces `required`; per-type schemas come with the first real content.

version.description: Content version, bumped on every change; recorded as <id>@<version>.

reviewedBy.description: Agents/people who approved this version, e.g. ["agent-10"]. Empty list = draft, not for release.
